content:
Not every day does a brand-new Apple TV app for tvOS make its debut. WordPress has just launched WordPress TV, bringing video content to the big screen.

According to the app's introduction, WordPress TV is a new way to watch "thousands of free lectures, tutorial videos, and WordCamp session recordings from WordPress meetups and events" on Apple TV.

Here's a detailed introduction to the WordPress TV app:

The video library of the WordPress community, all on the big screen. WordPress TV brings the complete WordPress.tv video catalogue to your television — thousands of free lectures, tutorial videos, and WordCamp session recordings from WordPress meetups and events around the world. Sit back on your sofa and learn from the people who build and use WordPress every day. Built natively for Apple TV, it delivers the best experience no matter where you are in the living room: use the remote to navigate a clean poster grid, and play smooth full-screen HD videos with ease. You can watch • WordCamp session recordings from events around the world • Lectures covering design, development, business, and content creation • Practical tutorials that teach you to use WordPress more flexibly • New videos uploaded by the WordPress community all the time

You can download WordPress TV from the App Store on Apple TV.
